summary: IDF forces achieved operational control of Hadatha village in southern Lebanon, destroying over 90 Hezbollah terror infrastructures and seizing more than 150 weapons. Simultaneously, the IDF eliminated a senior Hamas training commander in northern Gaza and struck operatives restoring a tunnel system near the Yellow Line. In the Gulf, a tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz near Oman, with Iranian state media confirming IRGC responsibility for targeting a Qatari gas vessel.
